translations.web: “For, behold, Yahweh commands, and the great house will be smashed to pieces, and the little house into bits.
translations.bsb: For the LORD gives a command: “The great house will be smashed to pieces, and the small house to rubble.”
translations.kjv: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
translations.asv: For, behold, Jehovah commandeth, and the great house shall be smitten with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
